entries.name: Spoedkliniek voor Gezelschapsdieren Midden-Nederland (Universitair Dierenziekenhuis Utrecht)
entries.duty: Mon-Fri 17:00-09:00 next morning; weekends and public holidays 24/7. Call first. Weekday daytime covered by the university clinic (UKG, 030-253 9411, vets refer via the Spoeddienst UKG which is stated as 24 uur per dag).
entries.note: University emergency clinic for dogs and cats, plus birds, small mammals, reptiles and amphibians with specialist back-up. Owners in Midden-Nederland can come directly outside office hours; see also /klinieken/gezelschapsdieren/spoeddienst/.
entries.quote: In het weekend en op feestdagen zijn we 24/7 geopend.

entries.name: Medisch Centrum voor Dieren (AniCura MCD) - Spoedkliniek
entries.duty: Emergency patients seen around the clock; vets and paraveterinarians on site at all times. Appointment/phone first. Specialist team not guaranteed 24/7.
entries.note: Regional night/weekend referral point for many Noord-Holland clinics (Den Helder, Almere, Haarlem area).
entries.quote: Voor spoedeisende patiënten is het MCD 24 uur per dag, 7 dagen per week open.

entries.name: AniCura Haaglanden (Spoedkliniek Rijswijk)
entries.duty: Spoedkliniek open 365 days a year, 24 h; referral clinic hours 08:00-17:00. Call for appointment.
entries.note: Serves the Den Haag region.
entries.quote: De spoedkliniek van AniCura Haaglanden is 365 dagen per jaar, 24 uur per dag geopend voor spoedzorg.

entries.name: AniCura Diergeneeskundig Verwijscentrum Dordrecht (Spoedkliniek)
entries.duty: Spoedkliniek every day 00-24; referral clinic weekdays 08:00-18:00. Closed 25/26 Dec, 1 Jan, 27 Apr (clinic hours; check by phone).
entries.note: Contact page also states 'Spoedkliniek 24/7 bereikbaar. Bel voor afspraak.'
entries.quote: 365 dagen per jaar, 24 uur per dag bereikbaar voor spoedzorg

entries.name: Evidensia Dierenziekenhuis Barendrecht (EDZ Barendrecht)
entries.duty: Emergency care 24 h, 7 days (Rotterdam region; Dierenziekenhuis Rotterdam refers here after 22:00).
entries.note: Chain spoed overview page lists 085 - 487 70 90 for Barendrecht; the location page gives 085 - 48 77 090 (same digits).
entries.quote: 24 uur per dag / 7 dagen per week

entries.name: Evidensia Dierenziekenhuis Zuidoost Brabant
entries.duty: Open every day, 24 h per day for emergency and second-line care (Eindhoven region).
entries.quote: Sinds juli 2020 staan wij 24 uur per dag, 7 dagen per week klaar voor spoed- en tweedelijnszorg.

entries.name: Evidensia Dierenziekenhuis Hart van Brabant
entries.duty: Open all day every day; 24/7 spoed (Tilburg / Den Bosch region).
entries.quote: 24 / 7 spoed

entries.name: Evidensia Dierenziekenhuis Arnhem
entries.duty: Open all day every day; vets available for emergency patients 24 h, 7 days.
entries.note: Chain overview page lists 026 - 333 37 30 (same digits).
entries.quote: 24 uur per dag, 7 dagen in de week klaar voor spoedpatiënten

entries.name: Evidensia Dierenziekenhuis Amsterdam
entries.duty: Open all day every day; emergency patients 24 h, 7 days. Located in Amstelveen, named Amsterdam.
entries.quote: staan 24 uur per dag, 7 dagen in de week klaar voor spoedpatiënten

entries.name: Evidensia Dierenziekenhuis Nieuwegein
entries.duty: Open all day, 7 days a week; teams 24/7 for emergency patients.
entries.quote: 24/7 voor spoed

entries.name: Evidensia Dierenziekenhuis Het Noorden
entries.duty: Open all day every day; 24/7 emergency clinic.
entries.note: Closest 24-h hospital to the city of Groningen.
entries.quote: 24/7 Spoedkliniek geopend

entries.name: AniCura Dierenziekenhuis Tilburg
entries.duty: Spoed listed 'Geopend voor spoed 00 - 24' every day (no explicit 24 uur / 24/7 / dag en nacht wording on the clinic or overview page); clinic hours Mon-Thu 08:30-19:00, Fri 08:30-18:00, Sat 09:30-12:30. Phone first.
entries.note: Downgraded by independent check 2026-11-03: the only 24-h support is a '00 - 24' spoed schedule, no explicit 24-h wording; phone first to confirm night care. Name, phone, address confirmed.
entries.quote: Geopend voor spoed 00 - 24

entries.name: AniCura Dierenziekenhuis Oldenzaal
entries.duty: Spoed listed 'Geopend voor spoed 00 - 24' every day (no explicit 24 uur / 24/7 / dag en nacht wording on the clinic or overview page); clinic hours Mon-Thu 08:30-19:00, Fri 08:30-18:00. Phone when in doubt.
entries.note: Downgraded by independent check 2026-11-03: the only 24-h support is a '00 - 24' spoed schedule, no explicit 24-h wording; phone first to confirm night care. Name, phone, address confirmed.
entries.quote: Geopend voor spoed 00 - 24

entries.name: AniCura De Tweede Lijn - Spoedkliniek Zwolle
entries.duty: Spoedkliniek (dierenartsenpost): Mon-Fri 18:00-08:00; weekends Sat 08:00 to Mon 08:00 (24/7); public holidays 08:00-08:00. Referral clinic 09:00-17:00. Together around the clock.
entries.note: AniCura Spoedklinieken overview lists it as 'Geopend voor spoed 00:00 - 23:59'. Page: service only for pets of participating veterinary practices; owners call their own vet first.
entries.quote: Weekenden, zaterdag 8.00 - maandag 8.00 uur (24/7)

entries.name: AniCura Breda - Dierenziekenhuis (spoedlijn)
entries.duty: 24-h PHONE emergency line to the on-duty vet (option 1). Clinic open weekdays to 20:30, Sat 08:00-12:00. From 22:30 at night, Saturday afternoons and Sundays patients are referred to AniCura Dordrecht or Rijswijk (staffed day and night).
entries.note: Phone on-call, not a 24-h open clinic. Address and hours from the clinic's contact page (https://www.anicura.nl/klinieken/breda/dierenziekenhuisbreda/contact/).
entries.quote: Onze spoedlijn is 24/7 bereikbaar.

entries.name: AniCura Dierenziekenhuis Zeeuws-Vlaanderen
entries.duty: 24-h PHONE emergency line: callers are transferred to the on-duty vet; weekend duty rota shared with partner clinics. Clinic hours Mon-Thu 09:00-19:30, Fri to 17:30, Sat 10:00-12:00. Call ahead.
entries.note: Phone on-call, not a 24-h open clinic. Zeeland coast (Zeeuws-Vlaanderen).
entries.quote: De dienstdoende dierenarts is 24/7 bereikbaar.

entries.name: Weekend spoeddienstrooster Zeeuws-Vlaanderen (AniCura Terneuzen, Dierenkliniek Terneuzen, Sas van Gent, Axel)
entries.duty: Four clinics rotate weekend emergency duty; on-duty vet reachable via 0115 - 61 96 28 (stated as staffed 24/7). Partners: Dierenkliniek Terneuzen (Vlietstraat 19, 0115 - 61 22 00), Dierenkliniek Sas van Gent (Zusterstraat 3, 0115 - 45 38 00), Dierenkliniek Axel (Oude Spoorbaan 2, 0115 - 56 14 88).
entries.note: Roster lists clinic per weekend (3-5 Jan to 26-27 Dec); year not stated on the page. Night duty also shared since 1 May 2024 (contact page).

entries.name: Spoed-dienstregeling Den Helder (AniCura Den Helder - MCD Amsterdam / 't Ossehoofd Heerhugowaard)
entries.duty: Outside opening hours (17:00-08:00) the main number routes to MCD Amsterdam (020 740 06 00); Tue and Thu also Dierenkliniek 't Ossehoofd, Heerhugowaard (072 574 49 59); every weekend Fri 17:00-Mon 08:00 MCD Amsterdam (Ossehoofd only some weekends).
entries.note: Page states the local clinic cannot offer 24/7 emergency care: 'Alleen lukt het ons niet om 24/7 spoedzorg te bieden.' Gateway to Texel ferry (Den Helder).

entries.name: Gedeeld dienstrooster Leeuwarden (AniCura Leeuwarden, Camminghaburen, Tusken Waed & Ie Stiens, Noord-West Friesland Franeker)
entries.duty: Outside opening hours call the clinic; you are transferred to the clinic on duty. Rota partners (from 1 Jan 2025): Dierenkliniek Camminghaburen, Kingmastate 32, Leeuwarden, 058-2669590; Dierenarts praktijk Tusken Waed & Ie, Popelierstrjitte 1, Stiens, 058-2571224; Dierenartspraktijk Noord-West Friesland, Het Want 4, Franeker, 0517-392100.
entries.note: Page does not describe a 24-h service; clinic hours weekdays 08:00-18:00, always reachable by phone for emergencies.

entries.name: Dierenziekenhuis Rotterdam (Pascalweg)
entries.duty: Emergency care Mon-Fri to 22:00 and weekends to 22:00; after 22:00 every day referred to EDZ Barendrecht (24 h). Clinic Mon-Fri 08:30-20:00, Sat 09:30-15:30.
entries.note: Page says it does not provide 24-hour care on site: 'Indien er 24 uurs zorg noodzakelijk is, verwijzen wij direct door naar EDZ Barendrecht'. Hours and address from /site/barendrecht page of the same site.

entries.name: AniCura Dierenkliniek Rotterdam - Ommoord Hillegersberg
entries.duty: Phone line 08:30-20:30; page says 'Emergency vet needed? Please contact our main location in Rotterdam Ommoord-Hillegersberg.' Contact before visit.
entries.note: Address from the AniCura clinic overview page (https://www.anicura.nl/spoedklinieken/); clinic hours 08:30-21:00 there. Four more AniCura Rotterdam locations exist (Centrum, Kralingen, Capelle, Zevenkamp area).

entries.name: DierenDokters Amsterdam
entries.duty: Mon 09:00-17:00, Tue-Fri 09:00-18:00, by appointment. Outside hours refers to the Emergency Clinic Amsterdam, 020-7400600.

entries.name: DierenDokters Utrecht (Tuindorp)
entries.duty: Mon-Fri 09:00-19:00, by appointment. Outside hours: Spoedkliniek voor Gezelschapsdieren Midden Nederland, 0900-2223000.

entries.name: DierenDokters Haarlem
entries.duty: Mon-Thu 09:00-19:00, Fri 09:00-17:00, by appointment. Uses Medisch Centrum voor Dieren Amsterdam for emergencies.

entries.name: Specialistische Dierenkliniek Utrecht (AniCura SDU)
entries.duty: Referral only, Mon-Thu 09:00-17:30, Fri 09:00-17:00; always call first. 24/7 reachable for veterinarians only.
entries.note: Not an owner-facing 24-h clinic: the 24/7 wording is for vets.
entries.quote: Wij zijn 24/7 bereikbaar voor dierenartsen

entries.name: AniCura Almere
entries.duty: Weekdays 08:30-18:00, Sat 10:00-14:00 (closed one Saturday in four). Outside hours the page refers to Medisch Centrum voor Dieren Amsterdam, 020 - 740 0600.

entries.name: AniCura 't Heike - Eindhoven
entries.duty: Regular weekly hours not shown on the opened page; has a 'Spoed' link to the AniCura spoedklinieken page. Clinic hours 08:00-17:00 per the AniCura overview.
entries.note: Nearest 24-h option: Evidensia Dierenziekenhuis Zuidoost Brabant, Geldrop.

entries.name: AniCura DC Hopmans - Hoogkerk (Groningen)
entries.duty: Clinic weekdays 08:30-18:00; out-of-hours emergency number 050-5015500 (no 24-h wording).
entries.note: Nearest 24-h option: Evidensia Dierenziekenhuis Het Noorden, Eelderwolde.

entries.name: AniCura Maaspoort - Den Bosch
entries.duty: Mon-Fri 08:00-18:00/19:00; outside hours a recorded message gives the number of the on-duty vet.
entries.note: 24/7 wording only in the page meta description; body says on-duty vet via recorded message, so not marked 24 h.
entries.quote: Voor spoed kunt altijd terecht, 24/7!

entries.name: AniCura Kennemerland - Velserbroek
entries.duty: Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri 08:00-20:00, Wed 08:00-17:00, Sat 09:00-17:00 (urgent treatments). Outside hours the number announces which spoedkliniek is on duty; MCD Amsterdam 020 - 740 06 00 or AniCura Rijswijk 085 - 483 13 00.
entries.note: Near Zandvoort / Haarlem coast. 24/7 only in meta description ('AniCura Kennemerland staat 24/7 voor u klaar'), not in hours; not marked 24 h.

entries.name: AniCura Dierenkliniek Bloemendaal
entries.duty: Mon-Thu 08:30-17:00. Daytime emergencies via the practice; outside hours call 020-740 06 00 for the on-duty vet. Saturday urgent care at AniCura Kennemerland, Velserbroek.
entries.note: Closest AniCura clinic to Zandvoort / Bloemendaal aan Zee beach area (about 10 km).

entries.name: AniCura Hoofddorp - Hoofdvaart
entries.duty: Mon-Fri 09:00-12:45 and 13:15-19:30; no weekend hours on page; phone when in doubt.
entries.note: Page contains no 24-h wording (a third-party directory claims 24/7; not used).

entries.name: AniCura Noordwijk (Dierenkliniek Rijngeest, locatie Noordwijk)
entries.duty: Mon-Tue 08:00-17:00, Wed-Fri 09:00-17:00 (closed 12:30-13:30). Banner says call 071 51 56 161 24 h a day for the on-duty vet; between 23:00 and 08:00 a recorded message refers to AniCura MCD Amsterdam.
entries.note: Page is internally inconsistent (banner promises 24-h phone, night spoed routed to Amsterdam; two different numbers), so not marked 24 h. Coast town.
entries.quote: Belt u ons 24 uur per dag op telefoonnummer 071 51 56 161.

entries.name: AniCura Zierikzee
entries.duty: Mon, Wed-Fri 08:00-19:00, Tue 08:00-17:30, Sat 09:30-13:30. Emergencies outside hours handled with other clinics in the region.
entries.note: Zeeland coast (Schouwen-Duiveland).

entries.name: AniCura Schouwen-Duiveland (Burgh-Haamstede)
entries.duty: Limited hours (Mon, Wed, Fri 13:00-16:00; Tue, Thu 10:00-16:00; Thu evening 17:30-19:00). Emergencies outside hours with other regional clinics; may be sent to Zierikzee.
entries.note: Zeeland beach holiday area.

entries.name: Dierenartspraktijk Terschelling
entries.duty: Page says reachable 24/7 for emergencies via the same phone number (phone on-call); appointments preferably by phone 08:00-09:30.
entries.note: Wadden island practice; phone on-call, not a 24-h open clinic.
entries.quote: Bij spoed 24/7 bereikbaar.

entries.name: Dierenartsenpraktijk Texel
entries.duty: Mon-Fri 08:00-18:00; tourist-board listing says available 24 hours a day for emergencies (phone on-call).
entries.note: Source is the island tourist board's company listing, not the clinic's own site (the clinic site could not be opened under the fetch provenance rule). Verify 24-h wording on the clinic site before publishing. Independent check 2026-11-03: name, phone, address and '24 hours a day for emergencies' confirmed on the tourist-board page; clinic's own site (dierenartsentexel.nl) could not be opened.
entries.quote: Available 24 hours a day for emergencies.

entries.name: Dierenartsen Dokkum (spreekuur Schiermonnikoog)
entries.duty: Mainland practice that covers Schiermonnikoog: no vet or emergency service on the island itself (clinic about once per 6 weeks, by appointment); the VVV page says Dierenartsen Dokkum can be contacted 24 h/7 days for emergencies by phone.
entries.note: Downgraded by independent check 2026-11-03: the VVV page confirms the 24-h wording but lists no phone or address for the practice, and the clinic's own site could not be opened; phone/address NOT confirmed - verify before use. 24-h is phone contact only.
entries.quote: Wanneer u een spoedgeval heeft kunt u 24 uur per dag 7 dagen per week contact met Dierenartsen Dokkum opnemen.

entries.name: Nova Spoed- en Verwijskliniek
entries.note: Own site spoedzorg page; also states staff are there dag en nacht. During working hours the page advises calling your own vet first. Nearest 24-h option for Amersfoort, Hilversum and the Gooi (Amersfoort clinics De Berg and BeterBeest refer to it outside hours).
entries.quote: Wij zijn 24/7 geopend voor spoedgevallen

entries.name: Dierenkliniek de Waalsprong
entries.duty: Phone 024-3031101 24/7 for clients; weekends emergencies only.
entries.note: Phone-only 24/7 emergency availability for the clinic's own clients (not a walk-in emergency hospital); Saturday/Sunday closed to the public, emergencies only. Home page also shows a different "Bel ons" number (0488 482 900) - 024-3031101 is the number named in the emergency text.
entries.quote: We zijn voor onze klanten voor spoedgevallen 24-7 bereikbaar op: 024 – 303 11 01.

entries.name: Dierenkliniek Broerdijk
entries.duty: Weekdays 18-21 h an unnamed Nijmegen practice is on duty; after 21 h and at weekends Evidensia Dierenziekenhuis Arnhem.
entries.note: Out-of-hours emergency line 0900-1120123 (page: 0900-112 0123). Page does not state 24-h care itself.

entries.name: Spoeddienst Nijmegen (via Dierenkliniek Broerdijk)
entries.duty: Mon-Fri 18-21 h Nijmegen practice on duty; later and weekends Evidensia Arnhem.
entries.note: No per-day rota is published. Page says Mon-Fri 18.00-21.00 a Nijmegen practice (not named) takes spoed; after 21.00 and at weekends emergencies go to Evidensia Dierenziekenhuis Arnhem. A second (undated, older) Broerdijk page says the O.N.D. group (Het Overleg Nijmeegse Dierenartsen) alternates spoed duty every 24 h and the number routes to the vet on duty - the newer arrangement above takes precedence. Phone only.
entries.quote: Na 21.00u en in het weekend wordt de spoedzorg opgevangen door het Evidensia Dierenziekenhuis in Arnhem.

entries.name: Dierenkliniek St. Anna 404
entries.note: Spoed line 0900-1120123: Mon-Fri 9-21 h routed to the on-duty Nijmegen clinic; nights (21-9 h), weekends and holidays Dierenziekenhuis Arnhem. Treatment by appointment.
entries.quote: Via het spoednummer 0900 1120123 wordt u altijd automatisch doorgeschakeld naar de dienstdoende dierenkliniek.

entries.name: Dierenkliniek Maastricht (locatie Heer)
entries.duty: Out of hours: usual number or 046-4512417 press 1 to the on-duty vet; no 24-h claim.
entries.note: Three locations: Heer (043-2041091), Brusselsepoort, Mercatorplein 11, 6216 CJ (043-3433070), Amby, Ambyerstraat Noord 56, 6225 EG (043-3633772). Mon-Fri 09:00-17:30. Out of hours the usual number connects to the on-duty vet; spoed page gives 046-4512417 (press 1) for the service area Landgraaf, Maastricht, Heerlen, Nuth, Sittard, Brunssum, spoed duty by the clinics' daytime vets. No 24-h claim. AniCura Maastricht is permanently closed (since 28 March 2026).
entries.quote: Je wordt automatisch doorgeschakeld naar de dienstdoende dierenarts.

entries.name: Dierenkliniek Enschede
entries.duty: Shared Enschede/Hengelo/Lonneker duty circle; answering machine names the on-duty vet.
entries.note: Mon-Fri 08:30-17:30, by appointment; the 24/7 claim rests on a shared duty circle with six other clinics in Enschede, Hengelo and Lonneker (phone only: after hours the answering machine names the vet on duty). Spoed line 053-4305805.
entries.quote: zodat u 24/7 met uw dier bij een dierenarts terecht kunt

entries.name: Dienstkring Enschede-Hengelo-Lonneker (Dierenkliniek Enschede, Balk, Bos, Elze, Slangenbeek, Slotzicht, Twente)
entries.duty: Answering machine names the vet on duty; spoed surgery all week.
entries.note: Seven cooperating clinics: Balk (Hengelo) 074-7850932, Bos (Lonneker) 053-4317808, Elze (Enschede) 053-4357777, Slangenbeek (Hengelo) 074-2770010, Slotzicht (Enschede) 053-4324292, Twente (Enschede) 053-4306010, Dierenkliniek Enschede 053-4305805. No published rota: outside hours the answering machine of each clinic says who is on duty and gives that vet's number. Balk Dierenarts page confirms the same circle.
entries.quote: Als u belt buiten openingstijden, hoort u op ons antwoordapparaat wie de dienstdoende dierenarts is

entries.name: Dierenartsenpraktijk Enschede Boekelo
entries.duty: Spoed 7 days a week, day and night, by phone.
entries.note: Companion animals 053-4361616; horses and farm animals 053-4361666. Mon-Fri 8.30-16.30 by appointment; own page says it is available day and night for emergencies (phone).
entries.quote: Wij staan 24 uur per dag paraat voor dieren die spoedeisende hulp nodig hebben.

entries.name: Balk Dierenarts (Enschede)
entries.note: Second location Hengelo, Pruisische Veldweg 226, 7552 AE, 074-7850932. Mon-Fri only. Outside hours the fixed number plays which number reaches the on-duty vet; cooperates with the Enschede duty circle.
entries.quote: Op de band hoort u vervolgens welk nummer u kunt bellen om de dienstdoende dierenarts te bereiken.

entries.name: Dierenartsen Frowijn & Vermeulen
entries.note: By appointment. Phone-reachable for emergencies on public holidays and outside hours; no emergency care outside hours for birds and exotics.
entries.quote: Op feestdagen en buiten openingstijden zijn wij telefonisch bereikbaar voor spoedgevallen.

entries.name: Dierenkliniek De Berg
entries.note: Mon-Thu 8:30-20:00, Fri 8:30-18:00, Sat 9:30-13:00. Outside hours spoed via 0900-2223000 (Spoedkliniek Midden-Nederland, EUR 1 per call per page).
entries.quote: Spoedeisende hulp buiten openingstijden: 0900-2223000

entries.name: BeterBeest Dierenartsen (Amersfoort)
entries.note: Practice is closed evenings, nights, weekends and holidays; outside hours it refers to Nova Spoed- en Verwijskliniek, Tolweg 3, Baarn, 035-7820900. Closed Tuesday mornings: Diergeneeskundig Centrum De Vallei, Woudenberg, 033-2863276.
entries.quote: Tijdens avond-, nacht- en weekenddiensten en op feestdagen is onze praktijk gesloten

entries.name: DierenDokters Ede
entries.note: Mon-Fri 09:00-19:00, treatment by appointment. Outside hours the on-duty vet; spoed duty shared with Dierenziekenhuis Arnhem.
entries.quote: Buiten de normale openingstijden wordt u doorverwezen naar de dienstdoende dierenarts.

entries.name: Dierenarts Ede (Molenstraat)
entries.duty: Outside hours calls are routed to Evidensia Dierenziekenhuis Arnhem.
entries.note: Mon-Fri 08:30-18:00 by appointment. Outside hours Evidensia Dierenziekenhuis Arnhem vets take the spoed duty via the same number (no home visits during duty). Phone-based 24-h.
entries.quote: Er is altijd een dierenarts bereikbaar: 7 dagen in de week, 24 uur per dag!

entries.name: Dierenkliniek Kruizinga
entries.duty: After hours via answering machine; cooperation with Dierenziekenhuis Arnhem.
entries.note: Phone-based 24-h; after hours the answering machine says which number to call, and the clinic works with Dierenziekenhuis Arnhem (Meander 10, 026-3333730).
entries.quote: Wij zijn 24 uur per dag te bereiken op: 0318 – 613 420

entries.name: De Klomp Dierenartsen (locatie Ede)
entries.duty: On-duty vet until 23:00, then Evidensia Arnhem.

notes: First NL run 2026-11-03. Every entry source page was opened with WebFetch; search snippets and aggregators (dierenkliniek.nl directory, petla.app, openingstijden.nl, job sites) were used only to discover URLs, never as data. 24 h marked only where an opened page says 24 uur / 24/7 / 00-24 / dag en nacht. 24-h clinics (14): Spoedkliniek Midden-Nederland Utrecht (weekday nights 17-09, weekends 24/7), AniCura MCD Amsterdam, AniCura Haaglanden Rijswijk, AniCura Dordrecht, Evidensia Barendrecht, Geldrop, Waalwijk, Arnhem, Amstelveen (Amsterdam), Nieuwegein, Eelderwolde (Groningen), AniCura Tilburg (Berkel-Enschot), AniCura Oldenzaal (the last two and Zwolle rest on the 'Elke dag 00 - 24' spoed schedule), AniCura De Tweede Lijn Zwolle (18-08 weekdays + 24/7 weekends). Phone-only 24-h on-call, flagged in duty/note: AniCura Breda, AniCura Zeeuws-Vlaanderen (Terneuzen), Dierenartspraktijk Terschelling, Dierenartsenpraktijk Texel, Dierenartsen Dokkum (Schiermonnikoog). Not marked 24 h despite 24/7 wording: AniCura Maaspoort Den Bosch (meta description only), Velserbroek (meta only), Noordwijk (inconsistent page), AniCura Maastricht (page titled PERMANENT GESLOTEN yet meta says 24/7 - skipped entirely), SDU Utrecht (24/7 for vets only). The Evidensia 'Spoed' overview page claims all hospitals 7 days/24 h but also lists 'Spoed Overdag Mon-Fri 06:00-18:00'; only hospitals whose own page states 24/7 are marked. Duty rotas (3): AniCura Zeeuws-Vlaanderen weekend roster, AniCura Den Helder out-of-hours rota (MCD Amsterdam / 't Ossehoofd), AniCura Leeuwarden shared roster. The Netherlands has no national or chamber-run (KNMvD) public duty list that could be opened. Poison line (1): NVIC (030-274 88 88) from a 2017 KNMvD infographic; no animal-specific owner line was found, the NVIC is a human centre that also advises vets; the RIVM page states vergiftigingen.info is professionals-only. Phone and owner access must be re-verified. News/parliament context (NOS, NH Nieuws, Kamervragen 2024Z09637): spoed care is shrinking; Evidensia Den Haag night service was closed (owners sent to Amsterdam or Barendrecht), so Den Haag has no 24-h clinic of its own - Rijswijk is the nearest (AniCura Haaglanden). NH Nieuws 2021 (West-Friesland night rota Bovenkarspel/Zwaag/Enkhuizen) is outdated and not included. Not reachable / not obtained: evidensia.nl root (provenance), AniCura Hilversum contact page (client error), dierenartsentexel.nl (not fetchable), vvvameland.nl dierenwelzijn page (not fetchable), own clinic sites for Nijmegen, Maastricht (AniCura closed), Enschede, Amersfoort, Haarlem-based practices other than DierenDokters, Zandvoort (no clinic in town found; Bloemendaal/Velserbroek/Noordwijk are the nearest), Vlieland (vlieland.net search found no vet page), Ameland (vet listing not opened), Schiermonnikoog (no island practice, see Dokkum). Cats: De Kattenkliniek van Groningen (Van Lenneplaan 15, 050-8531899) and Dierenkliniek de Ark Oost-Souburg, Dierenkliniek Almeloord Almelo, Dierenziekenhuis Assen (Pelikaanstraat 2) appear in a third-party directory as 24/7 but their own sites were not found, so none were added. Left for follow-up: own-site research for Nijmegen, Maastricht, Enschede, Almelo, Assen, Amersfoort, Ede, Zandvoort; Ameland and Vlieland vets; KNMvD regional duty lists; confirm NVIC number on a current official page; Evidensia Den Haag status; remaining AniCura locations (84 listed) and non-chain independent clinics. Independent check 2026-11-03 (random seed 20261103): 26 entries opened (23 mandatory + 3 random of 17 other clinics); 0 phone/address errors found, 2 notes amended; 3 downgraded to emergency_24h false (AniCura Tilburg and Oldenzaal: only a '00 - 24' schedule; Dierenartsen Dokkum: phone/address not on the cited page); 1 removed (NVIC poison line: current page says the line is for doctors and other healthcare professionals, no owner access). Superseded statements above: 24-h count is now 16 (12 staffed + 4 phone-only on-call: Breda, Terneuzen, Terschelling, Texel); Tilburg/Oldenzaal/Dokkum are no longer 24 h; the NVIC entry is deleted. Confirmed entries carry checked 2026-11-03. Follow-up run 2026-11-03 (Nijmegen, Maastricht, Enschede, Amersfoort, Ede, Zandvoort, Vlieland, Ameland, AniCura/Evidensia remainder): added 29 entries. 24 h (phone-based or hospital, wording quoted from the clinic page): Nova Spoed- en Verwijskliniek Baarn (staffed 24/7, nearest to Amersfoort/Hilversum), Dierenkliniek de Waalsprong Nijmegen, Dierenkliniek Enschede (via duty circle), DAP Boekelo, Dierenarts Ede, Kruizinga Ede, De Klomp Ede, DAP Noord-West Friesland (Vlieland), A7 Noord Drachten. Duty rotas (3): Nijmegen out-of-hours arrangement (Broerdijk; Evidensia Arnhem after 21 h), Enschede-Hengelo-Lonneker circle, A7 Noord weekly table. Checked AniCura's own spoed overview (84 clinics): it has no clinic in Nijmegen, Enschede, Amersfoort, Ede, Zandvoort, Vlieland or Ameland and AniCura Maastricht is permanently closed, so no further AniCura 24-h location exists beyond those already listed (the overview shows 'Geopend voor spoed 00 - 24' for Amsterdam, Berkel-Enschot, Oldenzaal, Dordrecht verwijscentrum, Rijswijk and 00:00-23:59 for Zwolle; 24-h status of Tilburg/Oldenzaal stays false per the earlier independent check). Evidensia's own site lists only the seven hospitals already included. Not reachable / skipped: dierenartsenamersfoort.nl and dierenkliniek-glanerbrug.nl (302 redirect loop between https and http, twice), almeloord.nl (client error, twice), boerskotten.nl (redirect, not retried further), AniCura/Evidensia pages not linked from search (provenance-blocked). Ameland: only an island info site was reachable for the vet (no clinic site found), Vlieland has no island practice (mainland consultations). Ede and Nijmegen: further independent clinics exist (e.g. Dierenkliniek Lent, Dierenartspraktijk Wijchen, Dierenkliniek Velp/Kortenoord Wageningen) but their own pages were not opened. Left for follow-up: Almelo (Almeloord), Glanerbrug, Amersfoort (dierenartsenamersfoort.nl, ABC voor Dieren, Zielhorst), Nijmegen Lent/Wijchen, Wageningen, remaining non-chain clinics in other provinces. Independent check 2026-11-03 (follow-up): a second agent opened the source_url of all 9 new 24-h clinics, all 3 new duty rotas and 4 random other new clinics (seed 20261103: Maastricht Heer, Frowijn & Vermeulen Enschede, Schols Ameland, De Kooikershof Almelo) - 16 checked / 0 fixed / 0 downgraded / 0 removed. Name, phone, address and the explicit 24 uur / 24-7 / dag en nacht wording (or the phone-only duty-circle basis stated in the entry) were confirmed on the pages; the Maastricht 046-4512417 spoed number is on the clinic's /spoed page, not on /contact.
